text.p: Nokia-Maillefer Holding said it had signed a contract to acquire Dolci Extrusion Spa of Milan, which specialises in production lines and components for the extrusion of plastic film and sheet.
Dolci Extrusion employs 130 people and had 1996 net sales of 37 million Swis francs.
Nokia-Maillefer, a leading supplier of cable manufacturing systems, said last month it had signed a letter of intent to acquire the company. It gave no financial details.

It said the purchase strengthened its presence in segments of plastics extrusion beyond wire and cable. "Important synergy gains are expected to materialise through leveraging Nokia-Maillefer's competence in plastics extrusion and the worldwide sales and service network," it said in a statement.

Dolci Extrusion will be consolidated into Nokia-Maillefer's results as of July 1997. "The impact of this acquisition on net results of 1997 should net yet be significant. The management expects clear contributions to Nokia-Maillefer's profit as of 1998," it said.
